2026-11-18-item-3-stamps.webp | Three stamps on 129 by 129 points a meter apart, a dome of 18 m, a plateau at 8 m that replaces and a crater of 6 m added over the corner, drawn from the module's own tiles on the CPU by build/reading.cs, oblique and from above, lit by a sun 33 degrees high from the top left.
2026-11-18-item-3-erosion.webp | Noise and a cone of 36 m before thermal erosion, after 600 passes at a talus of 0.6 with each point against the four beside it along X and Z, which slumps the cone into a square pyramid whose diagonal faces stand at the square root of two times the talus, and against the eight about it with the diagonals over the square root of two, which leaves eight faces, oblique, lit from above and in contours of a meter.
2026-11-18-item-3-splat.webp | The splat map's four materials over three stamps, noise and a steep cone, sand below 1 m, grass to 12 m, rock above a steepness of 0.7 and snow above 14 m, each blending into the next and blended in the picture by their weights, oblique, from above and in contours.
2026-11-18-item-3-droplets.webp | Noise, a dome of 40 m and a cone of 30 m on 193 by 193 points before hydraulic erosion, after 150,000 droplets reckoned against 40 m with the edge worn by every droplet leaving over it and filled by none, which dug pits without end, and after the same droplets with the edge held as the base level, which cuts gullies down both hills and fills their feet, oblique, lit from above and in contours of a meter.
2026-11-18-item-3-placement.webp | Trees kept from a place every 1.5 m on the splat ground by a rule of grass from 1 to 12 m no steeper than 0.4 and the grass's weight as their density, each a dark point, standing on the plateau, the dome's grass and the crater's rim and on no rock, sand or snow.
2026-11-18-item-3-picture.webp | A picture of a ridge with a valley across it, 64 by 32 texels given through ILandscapePictures, stamped over 80 by 40 m at 18 m by the higher over noise and over 40 by 20 m at 6 m added to a dome, each faded in over its edge, oblique, from above and in contours.
2026-11-18-item-3-bench.webp | An every-step recipe at 513, 1,025, 2,049 and 4,097 points a side, the fastest of three runs' time a point of each stage and the bytes a point it allocates, the tiles' 57 bytes a point with an index array a tile falling to 33 with one shared a size.
2026-11-18-item-3-distance.webp | Tiles of noise and a cone drawn at a step by their distance, every point near in sand, every fourth in blue and every sixteenth in red, with no skirts, where white cracks run along the borders between steps, and with skirts hung for the coarsest step, where none does.
2026-11-18-item-3-droplets-blocks.webp | 150,000 droplets on noise, a dome and a cone, drawn anywhere over the field and a block of 64 points at a time with the blocks taking turns of 64 droplets, oblique, in contours and lit from above, and their difference four times, the hills, the count of their gullies and the plains alike and the difference darkest along single gullies, which run in other places.
2026-11-18-item-3-normal-map.webp | Noise and a cone on 257 by 257 points drawn at every point, at every 16th point lit by its tiles' corners' normals, where the ridges between the corners blur into one slope, and at every 16th lit by the normal map sampled per pixel, where the field's own detail stands on the coarse tiles and the outline alone is coarse.
2026-11-18-item-3-thermal-gather.webp | Noise and a cone after 600 passes of thermal erosion at a talus of 0.6, each point's moves sent to its neighbors and each point gathering its share from them, oblique, in contours and lit from above, and their difference four times, white throughout since the two differ by one 255th of a channel at most.
2026-11-18-item-3-holes.webp | Noise and a cone with a hole of 6 m in the cone's flank and one of 10 m on the plain, the white ground showing through where no tile draws a cell, oblique and lit from above, and the contours from above running through both since a hole keeps the heights the steps left.
2026-11-18-item-3-masked.webp | Noise of 6 m masked by a picture of weights rising from nothing at the least X to one at the greatest across 128 by 128 points, the ground flat at one side, the noise whole at the other and a share of it between, oblique, lit from above and in contours.
2026-11-25-readme-erosion.webp | Noise with a dome of 40 m and a cone of 30 m on 193 by 193 points, drawn oblique and lit from one side at nine samples a pixel, before hydraulic erosion and after 150,000 droplets, the hills cut into channels and the ground roughened.
